parole.significato: KN95; an air particulate filtration standard requiring 95% filtration of particules sized 0.3 microns across and larger
parole.testo: Borrowed from Chinese KN95, from Mandarin 口罩 (Kǒuzhào) + English N95, from an initialism of Not resistant to oil particles with 95% filtration efficiency in NIOSH air filtration ratings.
